After clawing back with a Turn 2 double KO, trainer failed to click Protect on Garchomp on Turn 3, allowing Scarf Lucario to wipe Garchomp with Ice Punch while Swampert cleaned Charizard. Pelipper was left isolated against Swampert's inescapable Yawn and Protect cycle.
